hr: Jovan Tišma je suosnivač ALL.ART i SolSea. Njegovo iskustvo proizlazi iz bogatog iskustva koje uključuje marketing i financije. U ranim danima svoje karijere, njegov glavni fokus bila je industrija zabave gdje je radio kao koncertni promotor, osnivač festivala (ForestFest) i menadžer za partnerstvo s robnom markom za Universal Music Group. Prešao je na enterprise blockchain gdje je suosnivao startup RealMarket koji je propao nakon 2 godine razvoja i došao do DeFi-a u WaykiChainu, tvrtki sa sjedištem u Hong Kongu s fokusom na dovođenje blockchaina u mase. U vrijeme kada je tamo bio, obnašao je dužnost poslovnog direktora. Trenutačno se trudi u NFT prostoru s protokolom ALL.ART i tržištem SolSea.io na Solani u svrhu edukacije šire javnosti o prednostima prelaska na poslovni model Web3. Također, savjetnik je za StreamFlow Finance, Unique Ventures Club i Metakings studio, koji su svi Web3 projekti.
en: Jovan Tišma is the co-founder of ALL.ART and SolSea. His background comes from a wealth of experience that includes marketing and finance. In the early days of his career, his main focus was in the entertainment industry, where he worked as a concert promoter, festival founder (ForestFest) and brand partnership manager for Universal Music Group. He moved on to enterprise blockchain, where he co-founded startup RealMarket, which collapsed after 2 years of development. He landed DeFi at WaykiChain, a Hong Kong-based company focused on bringing blockchain to the masses. When he was there, he held the position of business director. He is currently working in the NFT space with the ALL.ART protocol and the SolSea.io market on Solana to educate the general public about the benefits of switching to the Web3 business model. He is also a consultant for StreamFlow Finance, Unique Ventures Club and Metakings Studio, all Web3 projects.

hr: Odvjetnik i partner u odvjetničkom društvu Hrdalo & Krnic. Osim Pravnog fakulteta završio je i poslijediplomski studij diplomacije. U svom radu fokusira se na nove tehnologije te je predsjednik Udruge za blockchain i kriptovalute (UBIK) kao i Radne grupe za legal tech pri Hrvatskoj odvjetničkoj komori
en: Lawyer and partner in the law firm Hrdalo & Krnic. In addition to the Faculty of Law, he completed postgraduate studies in diplomacy. In his work, he focuses on new technologies and is the president of the Association for Blockchain and Cryptocurrencies (UBIK) as well as the Working Group for Legal Tech at the Croatian Bar Association

role.hr: Croatian Game Development Alliance / Secretary general
role.en: Croatian Game Development Alliance / Secretary general

hr: Aleksandar Gavrilović je direktor studija za razvoj videoigara Gamechuck te glavni tajnik Klastera hrvatskih proizvođača videoigara. Autor je nekoliko videoigara na kojima je radio kao programer, pisac, game designer i producent, a neke od njih su i nominirane i nagrađivane na domaćim i svjetskim festivalima. Također je jedan od glavnih autora Trip the Ark Fantastic, prve hrvatske igre financiranje iz fonda europske unije Kreativna Europa, a trenutno radi i na adaptaciji Profesora Baltazara u videoigru.
en: Aleksandar Gavrilović is the director of the Gamechuck video game development studio and the general secretary of the Cluster of Croatian Video Game Producers. He is the author of several video games on which he worked as a programmer, writer, game designer and producer, and some of them were nominated and awarded at national and international festivals. He is also one of the main authors of Trip the Ark Fantastic, the first Croatian game funded by the European Union's Kreativna Europa fund, and he is currently working on adapting Professor Baltazar into a video game.

hr: Igor Belan je osnivač i glavni urednik najvećeg hrvatskog gaming portala HCL.hr, a kroz posljednjih 12 godina stvorio je i preko 2500 YouTube videa u kojima razmišlja o igrama, igranju, budućnosti, tehnologiji i ekonomiji iza svega toga.
en: Igor Belan is the founder and editor-in-chief of the largest Croatian gaming portal, HCL.hr. Over the past 12 years, he has created over 2,500 YouTube videos in which he thinks about games, gaming, the future, technology and the economy behind it all..

hr: Diplomirao je nanoelektroniku i optoelektroniku te magistrirao obradu signala i automatizaciju na Elektrotehničkom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Beogradu. Kao serijski poduzetnik, osnovao je i razvio 5 inovativnih tvrtki od 2008., 2 inženjerske tvrtke i 3 startupa, prvi put izašao je 2015. iz tvrtke koja sada ima preko 600 zaposlenika i urede na 3 kontinenta. Kao inženjer i voditelj projekta razvio je softverska i hardverska rješenja za više pametnih gradova i IoT projekata uključujući stambene i poslovne prostore, industrijske zone, proizvodne pogone za Michelinove i UNESCO zaštićene lokacije. Razvio je i vodio više projekata i timova za razvoj softvera, od mobilnih aplikacija do prilagođenih multimodalnih ERP/CRM sustava.
en: He graduated in nanoelectronics and optoelectronics and received a master's degree in signal processing and automation at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, University of Belgrade. As a serial entrepreneur, he founded and developed 5 innovative companies since 2008, 2 engineering companies and 3 startups; he first exited in 2015 from a company with over 600 employees and offices on 3 continents. As an engineer and project manager, he has developed software and hardware solutions for several smart cities and IoT projects, including residential and commercial spaces, industrial zones, and production facilities for Michelin and UNESCO-protected locations. He has developed and managed multiple software development projects and teams, from mobile applications to custom multimodal ERP/CRM systems.

hr: Co-Founder of Polygon Balkan Hub

Product development manager & Product strategist za blockchain proizvode od 2018. godine. Suosnivač BitX.hr, blockchain razvojne i konzultantske tvrtke. Kokreator hrvatske kriptomarke i suosnivač Uptownrecords.eu, prve hrvatske NFT izdavačke kuće
en: Co-Founder of Polygon Balkan Hub

Product development manager and product strategist for blockchain products since 2018. BitX d.o.o. was founded on February 27, 2018 in Zagreb, Croatia. Since the foundation, the primary focus has been on blockchain technology, the development of blockchain projects and the cryptocurrency market. It is more difficult to manage systems based on blockchain technology, cryptocurrency mining with specialized computer equipment, and mastering financial analytics and cryptocurrency trading.

role.hr: Croatian Chamber of Commerce (HGK) / Head of the Information Security Department
role.en: Croatian Chamber of Commerce (HGK) / Head of the Information Security Department

hr: Dr.sc. Dražen Lučić je svoje znanstvene titule stekao na Fakultetu elektrotehnike i računarstva Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Dodatno se školovao za korporativno upravljanje, za članove nadzornih i upravnih odbora. Nakon preko 20 godina provedenih radeći uglavnom na rukovodećim položajima u tvrtki „Ericsson“, većinom u državama Zapadne Europe, vratio se u Hrvatsku, gdje je deset godina radio u Hrvatskoj regulatornoj agenciji za mrežne djelatnosti (HAKOM), prvo kao ravnatelj, a onda kao predsjednik Vijeća. Od 2019. radi u Hrvatskoj gospodarskoj komori (HGK) kao voditelj Odjela za informacijske sigurnosti. Između ostalog, bio je član uprave BEREC-a, europskog regulatornog tijela za elektroničke komunikacije (2013. – 2018.), Nacionalnog vijeća za digitalno gospodarstvo (2014. – 2018.) i Nacionalnog vijeća za kibernetičku sigurnost (2016. – 2018.). Certificiran je interni auditor za kibernetičku sigurnost operatora ključnih usluga i davatelja digitalnih usluga. Član je Hrvatske udruge menadžera sigurnosti (HUMS). Stariji je član (Senior Member ) IEEE.
en: Croatian Chamber of Commerce (HGK) / Head of the Information Security Department Ph.D. Dražen Lučić obtained his scientific degrees at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing, University of Zagreb. Additionally, he received training for corporate management for members of supervisory and management boards. After over 20 years spent working mainly in managerial positions in the company "Ericsson", mostly in the countries of Western Europe, he returned to Croatia, where he worked for ten years in the Croatian Regulatory Agency for Network Activities (HAKOM), first as director, and then as President of the Council. Since 2019, he has worked at the Croatian Chamber of Commerce (HGK) as head of the Information Security Department. Among other things, he was a member of the board of BEREC, the European regulatory body for electronic communications (2013-2018), the National Council for the Digital Economy (2014-2018) and the National Cyber Security Council (2016-2018). He is a certified internal auditor for cyber security of key service operators and digital service providers. He is a Croatian Association of Security Managers (HUMS) member. He is a Senior Member of IEEE.

hr: Hajdi je suosnivačica i direktorica deep tech startupa airt koji omogućuje kompanijama da analiziraju i predvide ponašanje svojih kupaca. Redovna govornica i panelistica na poslovnim konferencijama na temu umjetne inteligencije i startup scene, bila je imenovana među 100 najutjecajnijih poslovnih žena u Hrvatskoj, nominirana za Veuve Clicquot Business Woman Award te navedena među 100 najvažnijih STEM poduzetnika u Hrvatskoj. Hajdi je također suosnivačica PWMN Croatia, udruge koja promiče jednakost i ravnopravnost, u funkciji je predsjednice Hrvatske startup ekosustav udruge (Cro Startup). Ujedno je i predstavnica hrvatskog startup ekosustava pri Europskoj Komisiji i Parlamentu te sjedi
en: Hajdi is the co-founder and director of the deep tech startup Airt, which enables companies to analyze and predict the behaviour of their customers. A regular speaker and panelist at business conferences on artificial intelligence and the startup scene, she was named among the 100 most influential business women in Croatia, nominated for the Veuve Clicquot Business Woman Award and named among the 100 most important STEM entrepreneurs in Croatia. Hajdi is also the co-founder of PWMN Croatia, an association that promotes equality and equality and serves as the president of the Croatian Startup Ecosystem Association (Cro Startup). At the same time, she is the representative of the Croatian startup ecosystem at the European Commission and the Parliament and sits

hr: Posvećen izgradnji web3 prostora. Predsjednik StoneBlock Blockchain Association i Blockchain Huba. Izvršni direktor Endemic NFT Marketplace. -Makroekonomist sa vještinama upravljanja imovinom. Snažan financijski stručnjak s dva magisterija usmjerena na financijsko upravljanje i procjenu tržišta sa Sveučilišta u Splitu, Ekonomski fakultet Split / Bankarska grupa Societe Genarale. Iskusni kreator politike s dokazanom poviješću rada u industriji međunarodnih organizacija. Vješt u trgovačkim i ekonomskim politikama, digitalnoj ekonomiji - posebno implementaciji blockchain tehnologije.
en: Experienced policy advisor with a proven track record in the international organization industry. Skilled in trade and economic policies, analytical skills, digital economy - especially valuation and implementation of blockchain projects. Today, the Endemic CEO and Sone block the President.

hr: Serijski poduzetnik, izvršni direktor i osnivač Revuta, fintech startupa koji pomaže ljudima da upravljaju i uštede novac na svojim pretplatama koje podržavaju kripto. Bivši izvršni direktor i osnivač Vyoocama, nosivog komunikacijskog uređaja izgrađenog za podršku uslugama na terenu. Vedran ima međunarodno iskustvo u razvoju proizvoda i lansiranju proizvoda u Silicijskoj dolini. Vedran je rani usvojitelj kripto tehnologije, investitor u nekoliko kripto projekata i pobornik Cardano blockchaina.
en: Serial entrepreneur, CEO and founder of Revuto, a fintech startup that helps people manage and save money on their crypto-backed subscriptions. Former CEO and founder of Vyoocam, a wearable communications device built to support field services. Vedran has international experience in product development and product launch in Silicon Valley. Vedran is an early adopter of crypto technology, an investor in several crypto projects and a supporter of the Cardano blockchain.

hr: Enis Papić je Marketing Menadžer u kompaniji Coca-Cola HBC B-H, sa završenim Finansijskim Menadžmentom na Ekonomskom Fakultetu u Sarajevu. Čest govornik i panelista na biznis konferencijama, strastveni gamer i zaljubljenik u cryptovalute i nove trendove. Uvijek traži mogučnosti kako na što bolji način spojiti Gaming sa FMCG.
en: Enis Papić is a Marketing Manager at Coca-Cola HBC B-H, with a degree in Financial Management from the Faculty of Economics in Sarajevo. Frequent speaker and panellist at business conferences, passionate gamer and lover of cryptocurrencies and new trends. He is always looking for opportunities to combine Gaming with FMCG in the best possible way.

hr: Vjeko Srednoselec odgovoran je za poslovanje marketinške grupacije dentsu u Hrvatskoj. Nakon višegodišnjeg iskustva u offline i digitalnim medijima pomogao je lansirati dentsu u našoj regiji, postaviti iProspect kao vodeću performance marketing agenciju, te u međuvremenu sudjelovao u lansiranju i radu kreativne agencije Dentsu Creative, medijskih agencija Carat i dentsu X te podatkovne divizije Dentsu Data Labs. Strateškim nastupom i konstantnim provociranjem statusa quo doveo je dentsu u top 10 agencija u Hrvatskoj, sa daljnjim ambicioznim planovima, poput pokretanja europskog performance marketing huba u Zagrebu, content marketing divizije te lansiranja dentsu Gaming divizije 2021. godine, čime je dentsu postao prva agencija u Adriatic regiji koja pruža potpunu marketinšku uslugu spajanja brandova i gaming zajednice.Strateške i decision making vještine razvija već 30 godina, počevši sa Prince of Persia na 486-ici, preko različitih konzola, ali ostaje dosljedan PC-u. U metaverse-u živi već 18 godina.
en: Vjeko Srednoselec is responsible for the operations of the dentsu marketing group in Croatia. After several years of experience in offline and digital media, he helped launch Dentsu in our region, set up iProspect as a leading performance marketing agency, and in the meantime, participated in the launch and operation of the creative agency Dentsu Creative, the media agencies Carat and Dentsu X, and the data division Dentsu Data Labs. With a strategic approach and constant provoking of the status quo, he brought Dentsu into the top 10 agencies in Croatia with further ambitious plans, such as the launch of a European performance marketing hub in Zagreb, a content marketing division and the launch of the Dentsu Gaming division in 2021, making Dentsu the first agency in Adriatic region, which provides a complete marketing service for connecting brands and the gaming community. He has developed strategic and decision-making skills for 30 years, starting with Prince of Persia on the 486, through different consoles, but remains consistent with the PC. He has been living in the metaverse for 18 years

hr: Ilija Brajković je godinama aktivan na internetskoj sceni, a posljednjih deset godina se aktivno posvetio digitalnom marketingu. U duši geek, ali život ga odnio u nešto u čemu još više uživa. Partner u digitalnoj agenciji Kontra. Redoviti je predavač na mnogim konferencijama i seminarima u zemlji i inozemstvu, uvijek među najbolje ocjenjenim predavačima. Polaznici njegovih seminara i predavanja odlaze kući razmišljajući "uf, kako to do sada nismo radili, jedva čekam sve to početi primjenjivati".
en: Ilija Brajković has been active on the internet scene for years, and for the last ten years, he has been actively dedicated to digital marketing. He was a geek at heart, but life took him to something he enjoys even more. Partner in digital agency Kontra. He is a regular lecturer at conferences and seminars in the country and abroad, always among the best-rated lecturers. The participants of his seminars and lectures go home thinking, "Ugh, how come we haven't done this before? I can't wait to start applying it all".

hr: Ivanka Mabić Gagić izvršna je direktorica hrvatske podružnice tvrtke Httpool by Aleph. Riječ je o vodećem globalnom predstavniku najvećih medijskih platformi poput Mete, Snapchata, Spotifyja, Tik Toka, Twittera, Reddita i Digital Turbinea, koji vlastitom tehnologijom i stručnim znanjima gradi digitalni ekosustav u kojemu svi oglašivači imaju pristup mogućnostima digitalnih platformi. Ivanka od 2019. dolazi u Httpool Hrvatska te kreira i implementira globalnu viziju Htttpola na lokalnom tržištu. Zahvaljujući rastu i rezultatima, Ivanka je primila CROMA nagradu za Managera godine 2022. za srednja poduzeća.
en: Ivanka Mabić Gagić, Managing Director at Httpool, graduated in organization and management at the Faculty of Economics and is attending IEDC; MBA at Bled School of Management. She is the executive director of Httpool Hrvatska, an official partner of leading media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Snapchat, Spotify, Reddit, Digital Turbine. She gained her rich experience in the agency Bruketa&Žinić&Grey, where she managed some of the largest agency clients and internal projects in the position of director of international operations. Ivanka is a certified AOEC and Search Inside Yourself Leadership Institute executive coach and is dedicated to sharing best practices for leadership development.

hr: Dario Marčac ima 27 godina i TikTok je senzacija s pola milijuna pratitelja. Osnivač je najveće zajednice TikTok kreatora u regiji pod nazivom Crew i organizator je prvog TikTok meet-upa u Hrvatskoj. Povezujući TikTok s Instagramom Dario ima preko 650 000pratitelja koji konzumiraju njegov sadržaj. Vodi i kanale za nekoliko brendova koji su među prvima prepoznali snagu TikTok platforme koja je najbrže rastuća, a čiji je koncept drugačiji od Instagrama i Facebooka. Dario je ujedno i najmlađi kolumnist Jutarnjeg lista, te redovit gost konferencija i festivala: panel UEFA Futsal Lige prvaka na temu "Kako postati uspješna sportska organizacija", gdje je sudjelovao kao panelist i pokazao prednosti korištenja TikToka u sportskim organizacijama; kao predavač na WOLF konferenciji; My Smart City Zadar konferencija o digitalnim nomadima; kao moderator panela na konferenciji Cro Commerce 2021 vodio je raspravu o influencerima i njihovoj ulozi u marketingu; panelist na konferenciji Lider Marketing by Number, te Digital Summit Ljubljana. Sa samo 26 godina Dario je bio najmlađi predavač na Weekend Media Festivalu 2021. u Rovinju. Zbog činjenice da na TikTok platformi uspješno vodi desetke profila kompanija te da je njegov privatni sadržaj uvijek drugačiji i zanimljiv, mediji redovito prenose njegov rad. Njegov #BookTok izazov u kojem je sudjelovalo 16 školskih knjižničara iz cijele Hrvatske popraćen je u TV emisijama, brojnim novinama i časopisima
en: Dario Marčac is 27 years old and a TikTok sensation with half a million followers. He is the founder of the largest community of TikTok creators in the region, Crew, and the organizer of the first TikTok meet-up in Croatia. Connecting TikTok with Instagram, Dario has over 650,000 followers consuming his content. He also runs channels for several brands that were among the first to recognize the power of the fastest-growing TikTok platform, whose concept differs from Instagram and Facebook. Dario is also the youngest columnist of Jutarnji List and a regular guest at conferences and festivals: UEFA Futsal Champions League panel on "How to become a successful sports organization", where he participated as a panellist and showed the benefits of using TikTok in sports organizations; as a lecturer at the WOLF conference; My Smart City Zadar conference on digital nomads; as panel moderator at the Cro Commerce 2021 conference, he led a discussion on influencers and their role in marketing; panellist at the Lider Marketing by Number conference and Digital Summit Ljubljana. At only 26 years old, Dario was the youngest lecturer at the Weekend Media Festival 2021 in Rovinj. Because he successfully manages dozens of company profiles on the TikTok platform and his private content is always different and interesting, the media regularly broadcasts his work. His #BookTok challenge, in which 16 school librarians from all over Croatia participated, was covered in TV shows, numerous newspapers and magazines

hr: Dino Oreški karijeru je počeo u Neckermannu prije 14 godina, a prvi radni zadatak nakon diplome mu je bio – preseliti katalog na webshop. Nakon toga postaje voditelj eCommerce odjela u Quelleu gdje je zadužen za vođenje tima i u to vrijeme najvećeg webshopa u Hrvatskoj. Potom prelazi u KG Mediju, agenciju specijaliziranu za promociju hrvatske turističke ponude gdje provodi online oglašivačke kampanje bazirane na online bookinzima, za sve vodeće hrvatske hotelijerske kuće. Iduća postaja je Inventa, na poziciji Web & eCommerce managera gdje je bio project manager web shopova. Vraća se u turizam, u Dubrovačke Vrtove Sunca te nakon četiri godine odlazi u IT svijet - u Span, gdje pokreće digitalni marketing. Danas je Chief Growth Officer u IntechOpenu, konzultant u agenciji Upping, suosnivač je i, također konzultant, u Udruzi eCommerce Hrvatska. Voli izazove i vjeruje da za svaki problem postoji rješenje. Pomiče granice uspješnim kombiniranjem tehnologije i marketinga. Za dodatnu inspiraciju često zaviri u razne knjige, blogove i članke.
en: Dino Oreški started his career at Neckermann 14 years ago, and his first task after graduation was to move the catalogue to the webshop. After that, he became the head of the eCommerce department at Quelle, where he was responsible for leading the team and, then, the largest webshop in Croatia. He then moved to KG Medija, an agency specialized in promoting Croatian tourist offers, where he implemented online advertising campaigns based on online bookings for all leading Croatian hoteliers. The next stop is Inventa, in the position of Web and eCommerce manager, where he was the project manager of web shops. He returns to tourism, to Dubrovnik's Sun Gardens, and after four years he goes to the IT world - to Span, where he starts digital marketing. Today, he is the Chief Growth Officer at IntechOpen, a consultant at the Upping agency, a co-founder, and a consultant at the eCommerce Croatia Association. He likes challenges and believes that there is a solution to every problem. It pushes the boundaries by successfully combining technology and marketing. He often looks at various books, blogs and articles for additional inspiration.

hr: Diplomirao međunarodno poslovanje i administraciju na Graduate School of Business u Grenobleu, magistrirao urbano i ekološko upravljanje na UN-ovom Sveučilištu za mir. Upravljao je inovacijskim procesima unutar kompanija iz tehnološkog portfelja, identificirajući strategije i poslovne prilike uključujući više blockchain startupa koji se bave sekundarnim tržištima, kripto ekosustavima, KYC-om itd. Radio je kao viši savjetnik u javnim institucijama uključujući Ministarstvo gospodarstva Srbije u EUBID projektu za jačanje kapaciteta poduzetničkih inkubatora i znanstveno-tehnoloških parkova koje financira Europska delegacija, a provodi GFA consulting GmbH. Dizajnirao je, razvio i upravljao višestrukim komercijalnim projektima financiranim od strane EU-a koji podržavaju inovacije, tehnologiju i poduzetništvo. Nemanja je osnivač Web3 Superclustera koji financira USAID kroz program Serbia Innovates.
POTHVATI: Blinking.id platforma za upravljanje identitetom (KYC/AML) i platforma za trgovanje na sekundarnom tržištu Realmarket.io na Hyperledger Fabricu.
en: Traken / co-founder / Moonstruck partner Graduated in international business and administration at the Graduate School of Business in Grenoble and a master's degree in urban and environmental management at the UN University for Peace. He managed innovation processes within technology portfolio companies, identifying strategies and business opportunities, including multiple blockchain startups dealing with secondary markets, crypto ecosystems, KYC, etc. He worked as a senior advisor in public institutions, including the Ministry of Economy of Serbia, in the EUBID project to strengthen the capacity of business incubators and science and technology parks financed by the European delegation and implemented by GFA Consulting GmbH. He has designed, developed and managed multiple EU-funded commercial projects supporting innovation, technology and entrepreneurship. Nemanja is the founder of the Web3 Supercluster, funded by USAID through the Serbia Innovates program.
VENTURES: Blinking.id identity management platform (KYC/AML) and secondary market trading platform Realmarket.io on Hyperledger Fabric.

role.hr: Hometown club / Founder · Creative Director / Clothing Designer and Gamer
role.en: Hometown club / Founder · Creative Director / Clothing Designer and Gamer

hr: Duje Stojak je kreativni direktor i vizualni umjetnik koji je karijeru započeo u američkom streetwear brendu Renowned L.A., te je danas CEO studija JetLag i CCO streetwear i entertainment brenda Hometown Club. S više od 12 godina iskustva u zabavnoj i modnoj industriji i rada na kreativnim strategijama i brendingu u različitim industrijama; s fokusom na streetwear, imao je priliku dizajnirati i kreirati kolekcije za više modnih brendova uključujući dizajn odjeće za razne glazbenike poput Chrisa Browna , Cardi B., Tygu, Nicki Minaj i mnogih drugih s radom koji su prepoznale brojne publikacije poput FORBES magazina, WWD, GQ., New York Times i drugi. “Leading the charge in redefining streetwear” - Forbes, Jan 14, 2020 U posljednje vrijeme primarni fokus u profesionalnom polju stavlja na istraživanje, propitkivanje i nuđenje rješenja kako bi tvrtke i individualci lakše mogli prevesti svoju priču i viziju u prostor novih tehnologija u nastajanju, sa snažnim fokus na tome kako isporučiti novu vrstu vrijednost i korisničkog iskustva kroz storytelling i gamifikaciju brenda kao marketinško i kreativno rješenje, te Web3 koncept kao tehnološko rješenje za skaliranje vizije brenda na etički i edukativni način. Osim Splita i Zagreba, često ga možete susresti u virtualnom svijetu, gradu zvanom Al Mazrah.
en: Creative Director / Clothing Designer and Gamer Duje Stojak is a creative director and visual artist who started his career in the American streetwear brand Renowned L.A. today, he is the CEO of the JetLag studio and the CCO of the streetwear and entertainment brand Hometown Club. With over 12 years of experience in the entertainment and fashion industries and working on creative strategies and branding in various industries, with a focus on streetwear, he had the opportunity to design and create collections for multiple fashion brands, including clothing designs for various musicians such as Chris Brown, Cardi B., Tyga, Nicki Minaj and many others with work recognized by numerous publications such as FORBES magazine, WWD, GQ., New York Times and others. "Leading the charge in redefining streetwear" - Forbes, Jan 14, 2020 Recently, the primary focus in the professional field has been on research, questioning and offering solutions so that companies and individuals can more easily translate their story and vision into the space of emerging new technologies, with a strong focus on how to deliver a new type of value and user experience through storytelling and gamification of the brand as a marketing and creative solution, and the Web3 concept as a technological solution for scaling the brand vision ethically and educationally. Apart from Split and Zagreb, you can often meet him in the virtual world, in a city called Al Mazrah.

role.hr: Grow! Project co-founder / idea creator of the first well-being magazine Sensa
role.en: Grow! Project co-founder / idea creator of the first well-being magazine Sensa

hr: Izabela Vrtar, novinarka i urednica s više od 20 godina iskustva u tiskanim i digitalnim medijima, pokretačica je i idejna začetnica prvog hrvatskog well-being magazine Sensa te projekata koji su posljednjih 16 godina pratili taj brend – Sensa Vikenda, Sensa Yoga Retreata, najvećeg festivala vitalnosti i ljepote Sensa dana u Maksimiru te mnogih drugih evenata i pop-up projekata pod brendom Sensa. Uz Sensu, bila je i glavna urednica Adria Luxury Societyja, prvog hrvatskog b2b medijskog izdanja i konferencije posvećenih luksuznim i premium projektima u Adria regiji. Svoje dugogodišnje uredničko iskustvo u lifestyle, well-being i luxury segmentu, danas koristi za kreiranje tailor made premium projekata za tvrtke i brendove. Uz konzalting i kreiranje medijskih i korporativnih proizvoda, Izabela Vrtar programski je savjetnik za poslovne i lifestyle konferencije i evente koje vodi i moderira.
en: Izabela Vrtar, a journalist and editor with more than 20 years of experience in print and digital media, is the initiator and creator of the first Croatian well-being magazine Sensa and the projects that have followed that brand for the past 16 years - Sensa Weekend, Sensa Yoga Retreat, the largest festival the vitality and beauty of the Sensa Day in Maksimir and many other events and pop-up projects under the Sensa brand. In addition to Sensa, she was also the editor-in-chief of Adria Luxury Society, the first Croatian b2b media edition and conference dedicated to luxury and premium projects in the Adria region. Today, he uses his many years of editorial experience in the lifestyle, well-being and luxury segments to create tailor-made premium projects for companies and brands. In addition to consulting and creating media and corporate products, Izabela Vrtar is a program consultant for business and lifestyle conferences and events that she leads and moderates.

hr: Dr. Ljevar je suosnivač Kubik Intelligencea, Data Scientist s multidisciplinarnim doktoratom informatike/psihologije, javni govornik i serijski poduzetnik. Specijalizirana je za korištenje velikih podataka i strojnog učenja za stvaranje najboljih uvida u klijente. Bivša je glavna konzultantica za znanost o podacima na DAMSL-u i gost predavač na magisteriju Business Intelligence na Sveučilištu Nottingham. Osim toga, autorica je recenziranih akademskih radova koji se odnose na psihologiju u velikim podacima i korištenje transakcijskih podataka za društveno dobro.
en: dr. Ljevar co-founded Kubik Intelligence, a Data Scientist with a multidisciplinary doctorate in informatics/psychology, a public speaker and a serial entrepreneur. She uses big data and machine learning to create the best customer insights. She is a former Principal Data Science Consultant at DAMSL and a visiting lecturer on the MA Business Intelligence at the University of Nottingham. In addition, she is the author of peer-reviewed academic papers related to the psychology of big data and the use of transactional data for social good.

hr: Lejla ima veliko iskustvo u B2B prodaji i marketingu s gotovo deset godina rada na najvećim svjetskim financijskim tržištima, blockchain industriji i industriji IT tehnologije. Dosadašnje iskustvo uključuje izgradnju, upravljanje i provođenje globalnih liderskih kampanja za izgradnju robnih marki,stvaranje potencijalnih klijenata i kupnju medija. U BeInCrypto, Lejla vodi operacije pay media i oglašavanja, kao i marketinški proces i razvoj na više platformi društvenih medija.
en: Lejla has extensive experience in B2B sales and marketing, with almost ten years of work in the world's largest financial markets, the blockchain and IT technology industries. Previous experience includes building, managing and executing global leadership campaigns for brand building, lead generation and media buying. At BeInCrypto, Lejla leads the paid media and advertising operations and the marketing process and development on multiple social media platforms.

role.en: Co-Founder / Gepek, Agriblock and Nanas Game

hr: Kristijan je iskusan poduzetnik s dokazanim uspjehom za startup, gaming i esport industriju. S preko 10 godina iskustva u startup svijetu, Kristijan je suosnivač nekoliko uspješnih startup, uključujući Gepek – platformu za zajedničko korištenje paketa i Degenerika - gaming & art studio koji su razvili nekoliko igara te su trenutno angažirani na Hero Labs projektu. K tome, suvlasnik je i Valiance Pro Game – esport kluba koji je stekao široko priznanje u industriji. Uz svoje poduzetničke pothvate, Kristijan je i traženi savjetnik i mentor te pruža smjernice i podršku za više od 17 projekata diljem Europe. Čest je govornik na događanjima i susretima, a sudjelovao je na više od 20 događanja i startup natjecanja. Također kroz svoj angažman za Polygon Labs kao advocate za regiju, aktivno je uključen u Web3 svijet te je pokrenuo Web3 Hub, platformu koja pomaže tvrtkama ući u Web3 prostor
en: Kristijan is an experienced entrepreneur with proven success in the startup, gaming and esports industries. With over 10 years of experience in the startup world, Kristijan co-founded several successful startups, including Gepek - a package-sharing platform and NanasGames - a gaming studio that developed the popular game Bitcoin Wars. In addition, he is a co-owner of Valiance Pro Game - an esports club that has gained wide recognition in the industry. In addition to his entrepreneurial ventures, Kristijan is a sought-after consultant and mentor who provides guidance and support for more than 17 European projects. He is a frequent speaker at events and meetings and has participated in over 20 events and startup competitions. He is also actively involved in the Web3 world and launched Web3 Hub, a platform that helps companies enter the Web3 space.

hr: S više od dva desetljeća iskustva rada u vodećem telekomu, Josipa je oblikovala, vodila i upravljala IT timovima. Po završetku studija pohađala je brojne edukacije iz područja komunikacija (verbalna, neverbalna, NLP, psihoterapija, coaching) stavljajući naglasak na wellbeing. Svojom ulogom Scrum Mastera i timskog coacha, posljednjih godina Josipa osigurava agilnost više desetaka timova. Kao trenerica za agilne načine rada, edukacije i prezentacijske vještine, u svom radu najčešće koristi drvene kockice za definiranje ciljeva. Voli metode eksternalizacije interpsihičkih procesa putem perceptivnih pozicija, što uključuje slaganje misli pomoću plastelina, kockica, papirića koje polaznici, timovi stavljaju pred sebe te uče kroz igru i zabavu prilagođavajući se temi, situaciji i cilju koji žele postići.
en: With over two decades of experience working in a leading telecom, Josipa has shaped, led and managed IT teams. After completing her studies, she attended numerous educations in communication (verbal, non-verbal, NLP, psychotherapy, coaching) with an emphasis on well-being. As Scrum Master and team coach, Josip has ensured the agility of dozens of teams in recent years. As a trainer for agile ways of working, education and presentation skills, she most often uses wooden cubes to define goals in her work. He likes methods of externalizing interpsychic processes through perceptive positions, which include arranging thoughts using plasticine, cubes, and pieces of paper that participants and teams put in front of them and learn through play and fun, adapting to the topic, situation and goal they want to achieve.

role.hr: Ceres Blockchain Solutions / Co-founder & Lead Developer
role.en: Ceres Blockchain Solutions / Co-founder & Lead Developer

hr: Završio master studije Softverskog inženjerstva i informacionih tehnologija na Fakultetu tehničkih nauka u Novom Sadu. Suosnivač je IT tvrtke Ceres Blockchain Solutions, specijalizirane za Web3 konzalting, outsourcing usluge, kao i razvoj internih projekata.
en: Completed master's studies in Software Engineering and Information Technologies at the Faculty of Technical Sciences in Novi Sad. He is the co-founder of the IT company Ceres Blockchain Solutions, specializing in Web3 consulting, outsourcing services, and developing internal projects.

hr: Završio osnovni studij telekomunikacija i informacijskih tehnologija na Visokoj školi strukovnih studija informacijsko-komunikacijskih tehnologija u Beogradu. Suosnivač je i direktor IT tvrtke Ceres Blockchain Solutions koja se bavi Web3 konzaltingom, outsourcing uslugama, kao i razvojem internih projekata.
en: Completed the basic study of telecommunications and information technologies at the University of Vocational Studies of Information and Communication Technologies in Belgrade. He is the co-founder and director of the IT company Ceres Blockchain Solutions, which deals with Web3 consulting, outsourcing services, and the development of internal projects.

hr: Đorđe Vukotić je Chief Sales & Operations OfficerJoberty-a, platforma zajednice radnih mjesta koja povezuje IT profesionalce s tvrtkama koje traže takve profile. U startap ekosustavu doneo je više od 15 godina iskustva, uglavnom iz značajnih multinacionalnih kompanija, kao i velikih domaćih/regionalnih sustava. Iskustvo koje je stekao radeći na međunarodnim tržištima, što u Europi, što u Americi i Bliskom Istoku, značajno mu je pomoglo u trenutnoj fazi razvoja Joberty-ja u internacionalnom skaliranju i pozicioniranju na međunarodnim tržištima.
en: Đorđe Vukotić is the Chief Sales & Operations Officer of Joberty, a job community platform that connects IT professionals with companies looking for such profiles. In the startup ecosystem, he brought more than 15 years of experience, mainly from significant multinational companies and large domestic/regional systems. The experience he gained working in international markets in Europe, America and the Middle East helped him significantly in the current phase of Joberty's development in international scaling and positioning in international markets.

role.hr: Good game global / Strategic partnership manager
role.en: Good game global / Strategic partnership manager

hr: Diplomirao telekomunikacije na Fakultetu Elektrotehnike i računarstva u Zagrebu, a trenutno radi na doktoratu na Institutu Jožef Štefan u Ljubljani u području robotike i ljudskog pokreta. Predaje elektrotehniku na Tehničkom Veleučilištu u Zagrebu, te radi kao Strategic partnership manager u Good Game Globalu, gdje je počeo kao voditelj studentskih projekata. Entuzijastičan u vezi procesa prijenosa znanja, esporta generalno, a sve manje slobodnog vremena provodi na treninzima trčanja i sportskog penjanja.
en: He graduated in telecommunications at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing in Zagreb and is currently working on his doctorate at the Jožef Štefan Institute in Ljubljana in robotics and human movement. He teaches electrical engineering at the Technical University in Zagreb and works as a strategic partnership manager at Good Game Global, where he started as a student project manager. Enthusiastic about knowledge transfer, esports in general, and spends less and less free time on running training and sport climbing.

hr: Vlasnik više tvrtki, serijski poduzetnik od 2012. godine kada je krajem fakultetskog obrazovanja pokrenuo prvi hrvatski digitalni automoto magazin – AutoIQ koji je naknadno uspješno prodan. Paralelno, u 2015. se pokreće i SIMPLI prodajno-marketinšku agenciju koja se bavi marketingom, prodajom medijskih usluga i organizacijom evenata, a od 2016. godine upravo SIMPLI agencija postaje ekskluzivna agencija za prodaju i marketing N1 Televizije, dok od 2021. godine ekskluzivno radi prodaju jedinstvenih content formata za HTV. Također u 2015. s nekoliko bliskih kolega i prijatelja s velikim iskustvom i znanjem u digitalnom marketingu i internet poslovanju pokreće eCommerce Hrvatska udrugu u kojoj je od početka član upravnog odbora, a od 2021. potpredsjednik Udruge. eCommerce Hrvatska se bavi promicanjem važnosti ecommercea i internet poslovanja, povezuje trgovce s provjerenim i pouzdanim nuditeljima usluga, organizira konferencije i edukacije te na tržište uvodi jedinstven nacionalni trustmark povjerenja – Trusted Shop. Tijekom 2017. godine pokreće treću tvrtku - DWIZARDS Web & Software Development agenciju. Tijekom 2021. pokreće četvrtu tvrtku FORCE INFO koja se također bavi marketinškim uslugama i savjetovanjem, a tijekom 2022. godine s nekoliko partnera osniva tvrtku I AMSTRONG d.o.o. koja se bavi proizvodnjom i prodajom vrhunske fitness opreme
en: He has owner of several companies and a serial entrepreneur since 2012, when at the end of his college education, he started the first Croatian digital automotive magazine - AutoIQ, which was subsequently successfully sold. In parallel, in 2015, the SIMPLI sales and marketing agency was launched, which deals with marketing, the sale of media services and the organization of events. Since 2016, the SIMPLI agency has become the exclusive agency for sales and marketing of N1 Television, while from 2021 it works exclusively sale of unique content formats for HTV. Also in 2015, together with several close colleagues and friends with great experience and knowledge in digital marketing and internet business, he started the eCommerce Croatia association, where he has been a member of the board of directors since the beginning and since 2021, the vice president of the Association. eCommerce Croatia promotes the importance of e-commerce and internet business, connects merchants with proven and reliable service providers, organizes conferences and training, and introduces a unique national Trustmark of trust - Trusted Shop - to the market. In 2017, he launched a third company - DWIZARDS Web & Software Development Agency. In 2021, he started a fourth company, FORCE INFO, which also deals with marketing services and consulting, and in 2022, he established the company I AMSTRONG d.o.o. with several partners. which deals with the production and sale of top fitness equipment

hr: Rođen u Zagrebu 1986. Završio Filozofski fakultet Sveučilišta u Zagrebu 2012. (BA povijest umjetnosti i komparativna književnost; MA povijest umjetnosti). Objavio je nekoliko knjiga i monografija o suvremenoj umjetnosti. Autor je monografije Božice Dee Matasić (2016.), Ivana Posavca (2020.); knjige eseja Selekcija (2018.), knjige o suvremenom hrvatskom slikarstvu Konkvistadori s kistom (2019.), predgovora fotografskoj knjizi Horizonti Ivana Posavca (2017), umjetničkoj knjizi Stipana Tadića Motivi iz okolice (2017.) i knjige Josipa Vanište Druga strana (2021.), koju je i uredio. Objavio je i niz članaka u knjigama i zbornicima. Redovito organizira izložbe i objavljuje eseje iz područja likovne umjetnosti.
en: Born in Zagreb in 1986. Graduated from the Faculty of Philosophy of the University of Zagreb in 2012 (BA in Art History and Comparative Literature; MA in Art History). He published several books and monographs on contemporary art. He is the author of monographs on Božica Dee Matasić (2016), Ivan Posavac (2020); the book of essays Selection (2018), the book about contemporary Croatian painting Konkvistadori s kist (2019), the foreword to the photography book Horizonti by Ivan Posavac (2017), the art book Motivi iz okolice (2017) by Stipan Tadić and the book by Josip Vanište Druga strana (2021) .), which he also edited. He also published several articles in books and anthologies. He regularly organizes exhibitions and publishes essays in the field of fine arts.

role.hr: Center for Missing and Abused Children / Head
role.en: Center for Missing and Abused Children / Head

hr: Tomislav Ramljak, po struci je socijalni radnik i radi kao voditelj Centra za nestalu i zlostavljanu djecu zadnjih petnaest godina, pokrenuo je Centar za sigurniji Internet i liniju za nestalu djecu u RH. Uža specijalnost usmjerena je prema zaštiti djece na internetu, predavač je na brojim stručnim nacionalnim i međunarodnim konferencijama. Zadnjih sedam godina je i stalni sudski vještak za zaštitu djece na internetu.
en: Tomislav Ramljak, a professional social worker and the head of the Center for Missing and Abused Children for the past fifteen years, started the Center for a Safer Internet and the Hotline for Missing Children in the Republic of Croatia. The narrower speciality is directed towards protecting children on the Internet; he is a lecturer at numerous professional national and international conferences. For the last seven years, he has been a permanent court expert for protecting children on the Internet.

hr: Unazad tri godine kreira izuzetno popularne Augmented Reality sadržaje za socialAR platforme poput Instagram, Meta, Snapchat i TikTok, a uz to educira.
en: For the past three years, he has been creating viral Augmented Reality content for social platforms such as Instagram, Meta, Snapchat and TikTok, and educating.

role.hr: Club1.io / founder · Dentsu / Head of Social & Influencers gaming & Web3 Strategy lead
role.en: Club1.io / founder · Densu / Head of Social & Influencers gaming & Web3 Strategy lead

hr: Mislav Combaj više od deset godina bavi se svim aspektima digitalnog marketinga kroz rad s globalnim brendovima. Odgovoran je za rad Social Media, Influencer marketing i Gaming divizije unutar Dentsu Creative u Hrvatskoj. Aktivno sudjeluje u pokretanju dentsu Gaming divizije 2021. godine, čime je dentsu postao prva agencija u Adriatic regiji koja pruža potpunu marketinšku uslugu spajanja brendova i gaming zajednice. Mislav je zaista 'jack of all digital' - znanje rado prenosi dalje, a višegodišnje iskustvo primjenjuje i na web3 projektima poput Club1 NFT branding platforme koja za svrhu ima kreiranje utility NFT kolekcija i plasiranje brendova i Influencera u web3 prostor. Aktivno sudjeluje u educiranju zajednice o prednostima novih tehnologija kroz predavanja i konferencije.
en: Mislav Combaj has been dealing with all aspects of digital marketing through work with global brands for more than ten years. He is responsible for the work of Social Media, Influencer marketing and Gaming division within Dentsu Creative in Croatia. Actively participated in the launch of the Dentsu Gaming division in 2021, making Dentsu the first agency in the Adriatic region that provides a complete marketing service for connecting brands and the gaming community. Mislav is truly a 'jack of all digital' - he is happy to pass on his knowledge, and he applies his many years of experience to web3 projects such as the Club1 NFT branding platform, which aims to create utility NFT collections and market brands and Influencers in the web3 space. Actively educates the community about the benefits of new technologies through lectures and conferences.

role.hr: Consultant for digital communications and branding
role.en: Consultant for digital communications and branding

hr: Tomislav Pancirov, konzultant za digitalne komunikacije i brendiranje. Najpoznatiji je digitalni nomad u Hrvatskoj te su ga o toj temi čak citirali i u Hrvatskom saboru dok se raspravljalo o vizama za digitalne nomade. Živi i radi po konceptu lifestyle biznisa po kojem se život ne prilagođava poslu, već posao životu.
en: Tomislav Pancirov, consultant for digital communications and branding. He is the most famous digital nomad in Croatia, and he was even quoted on this topic in the Croatian Parliament when visas for digital nomads were discussed. He lives and works according to the lifestyle business concept, according to which life does not adapt to work but work to life.

role.hr: Spectre technology / Cyber security consultant/ KnowBe4 partner
role.en: Spectre technology / Cyber security consultant/ KnowBe4 partner

hr: Tomislav Vuk je diplomirao elektrotehniku na FER-u i savjetnik je za cyber sigurnost. Partner je KnowBe4, vodeće svjetske tvrtke za cyber security awareness. Surađuje i s pojedincima kojima je stalo do cyber sigurnosti i tvrtkama kojima je želja obučiti ljude da prepoznaju cyber napade, odrade phishing testove i prepoznaju svoje ranjivosti. Sudjeluje na panelima i podcastima koji se tiču globalnih cyber prijetnji, cyber ratovanja i aktualnim trendovima na tom polju, a najviše je zainteresiran za aspekt ljudskog nivoa i razvoj sigurnosne cyber kulture među ljudima
en: Tomislav Vuk graduated in electrical engineering from FER and is a cyber security consultant. It is a partner of KnowBe4, the world's leading company for cyber security awareness. He works with both individuals who care about cyber security and companies who want to train people to recognize cyber-attacks, perform phishing tests and identify their vulnerabilities. He participates in panels and podcasts concerning global cyber threats, cyber warfare and current trends in the field. He is most interested in the human level aspect and the development of a security cyberculture among people.

hr: Tadej Slapnik is CEO at HashNET Slovenia, Co-founder of open distributed metaverse project Distriverse, Expert at UN/CEFACT, Expert Panel member at European Blockchain Observatory and Forum, Member of Technical Working Group at European Blockchain Partnership, Project lead at SI-Chain - blockchain service infrastructure in Slovenia. Tadej is actively involved in promotion, development and smart regulation of blockchain technology for achieving Sustainable Development Goals at national, European and global level
en: Tadej Slapnik is CEO of HashNET Slovenia, Co-founder of the open distributed metaverse project Distriverse, Expert at UN/CEFACT, Expert Panel member at European Blockchain Observatory and Forum, Member of the Technical Working Group at European Blockchain Partnership, Project lead at SI-Chain - blockchain service infrastructure in Slovenia. Tadej is actively involved in the promotion, development and smart regulation of blockchain technology for achieving Sustainable Development Goals at the national, European and global levels

hr: Petar je managing partner u Attic42 gdje pomaže osnivačima oko svega što se tiče njihovih proizvoda i poslovanja. Bilo da se radi o razvoju ljudi, izgradnji proizvoda ili formiranju i skaliranju timova i organizacija, on je predan stvaranju izvanredne vrijednosti i korisničkog iskustva. Prije osnivanja Attic42, Petar je bio COO u MVP Workshopu, jednoj od pionirskih europskih tvrtki za razvoj blockchain proizvoda, gdje je neposredno radio na vodećim projektima. On je bivši direktor proizvoda u Celsius Network. Vodio je odjel za zadovoljstvo kupaca u GoDaddy (nakon akvizicije ManageWP-a 2016., gdje je Petar bio dio izvršnog vodstva Devana Technologies). Diplomirao je na Matematičkom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Beogradu - smjer informatika i računarstvo.
en: Petar is a managing partner at Attic42 where he helps the founders around everything related to their products and business. Even if you shave about developing people, building products or forming and scaling fear of organization, he is committed to creating extraordinary value and user experience. Before founding Attic42, Petar was COO at MVP Workshop, one of the pioneering European companies for the development of blockchain products, where he directly worked on leading projects. He is a former director of product at Celsius Mesh. I want to see you go to GoDaddy (after the acquisition of ManageWP in 2016, where Petar was an executive management of Devana Technologies). I graduated in mathematics faculty of the University of Belgrade - major in informatics i Computer Science.

hr: Nakon 13 godina rada u e-sportu zainteresirao se za web3 te pronašao dom na Solani. Uskoro je dobio priliku raditi na vodećim pozicijama nekoliko projekata, između ostalog i kao CPO za prvi Solana wallet. Osim dubokog razumijevanja bizdev, strateške i marketinške strane blockchain ekosustava, jako dobro barata i s tehničkom stranom pa je pomogao postaviti NFT standard na Solani. U listopadu prošle godine pokreće vlastitu agenciju za blockchain savjetovanje - BlastCtrl. Glavna motivacija bila je rad sa što većim brojem različitih kvalitetnih projekata u čemu i dalje uživa više od svega. U zadnjih godinu dana pomogao je preko 25 projekata. Uz to je i vlasnik nekoliko sličica duhova, majmuna i ostalih životinja.
en: After 13 years of work in e-sports, he became interested in web3 te found a home on Solana. Soon he got the opportunity to work on the leading positions in several projects, including as CPO for the first one Solana wallet. In addition to a deep understanding of bizdev, strategic and the marketing side of the blockchain ecosystem, he handles it very well and on the technical side, so he helped set the NFT standard on Solana. In October of last year, he launched his own blockchain agency consulting - BlastCtrl. The main motivation was to work with what a large number of different quality projects, which he continues to enjoy more than anything. In the last year, he helped over 25 projects. In addition, he is also the owner of several images of ghosts, monkeys and other animals.

hr: Nandino Lončar radi kao GDPR konzultant i vanjski službenik za zaštitu podataka. Vlasnik je obrta Opt in consulting koji se bavi organizacijom poslovnih procesa u svrhu sigurnosti osobnih podataka i drugih informacija unutar poslovnog subjekta. Sedam je godina proveo i u IT svijetu te je jedan od pokretača udruge Osijek Software City. Voli provoditi edukacije i organizirati konferencije.
en: Nandino Lončar works as a GDPR consultant and external officer for data protection. He is the owner of the business Opt in consulting organization of business processes for the purpose of personal security data and other information within the business entity. It's seven spent years in the IT world and is one of the initiators of the association Osijek Software City. He likes to conduct trainings and organize conferences.

role.hr: Sensen’s World / TWITCH partner & gaming content creator
role.en: Sensen’s World / TWITCH partner & gaming content creator

hr: U gaming svijetu poznatija kao "Sansen", kreatorica brenda "Sansen's World". Bivša profesionalna tenisačica, informatičarka po struci, ali i velika gamerica od malih nogu, svestrana Sanda aktivna je u PC gaming i esports industriji od 2016. godine. S dubokim poznavanjem financijske i auto industrije, posjeduje vještinu analiziranja financijskog i komercijalnog položaja tvrtke te savjetovanja o operativnom poboljšanju. Prije Make IT Easy-a, Marko je bio Direktor prodaje tvrtke Mercedes Benz Leasing Hrvatska, dio Daimler Mobility Grupe. Također je obnašao različite pozicije u tvrtkama HYPO Alpe-Adria-Leasing i HT-Hrvatske telekomunikacije. Posjeduje iskustvo u upravljanju prodajom, korisničkim uslugama i marketinškim operacijama za financijske organizacije. Također je bio odgovoran za vođenje prodajnih i operativnih timova, dizajniranje i implementaciju strateških planova za postizanje ciljeva tvrtke. Marko je sa poslovnim teamovima ostvario mnoge uspjehe u svojoj karijeri, uključujući drugo mjesto po rastu prodaje u 2018. na globalnoj razini u Daimler Mobility natjecanju. Vrlo je orijentiran na uspjeh svojih klijenata.
en: Marko Stojaković is a financial expert with experience in development financial solutions, project management and business assessment model. Marko is the co-founder of Make IT Easy d.o.o. who deals with developing software solutions for fleet management, where he holds the position of a member of the board for finance. With deep with knowledge of the financial and auto industry, he has the skill analyzing the financial and commercial position of the company and consulting on operational improvement. Before Make IT Easy, Marko was the Sales Director of Mercedes Benz Leasing Croatia, part of the Daimler Mobility Group. He also held various positions positions in the companies HYPO Alpe-Adria-Leasing and HT-Hrvatske telecomunications. Has experience in sales management, customer service and marketing operations for financial organisations. He was also responsible for managing the sales and operational teams, designing and implementing strategic plans to achieve the company's goals. Marko is with business teams achieved many successes in his career, including second place in terms of sales growth in 2018 globally in Daimler Mobility competition. He is very oriented towards the success of his people clients.

hr: Boris Barbir je suosnivač i COO u Pine Studiju, hrvatskom game development studiju poznatom po hit igrama kao što su Escape Simulator, SEUM, Faraway, Birdcage i Cats in Time. With more than 30 millions of players who enjoyed their creations, the studio considered one of the most successful in the region. en: From humble beginnings in the film industry to EU projects to the video game industry, Lovro has found his ideal place in the education of new generations of game developers. As a director and the founder of Machine, is responsible for the company's development and career counseling of all participants that helps them to more easily and with experienced leadership find their place in one of the fastest growing industry in the world. Machina has been operating for ten years educated more than 1,200 participants, many of whom are already veterans of this industry with several published titles in its portfolio.

name: Doc. dr. sc. Lana Ciboci Perša

hr: Doc. dr. sc. Lana Ciboci Perša zaposlena je na Hrvatskom katoličkom sveučilištu. Predaje kao vanjska suradnica i na Fakultetu hrvatskih studija te na Učiteljskom fakultetu Sveučilišta u Zagrebu. Potpredsjednica je Društva za komunikacijsku i medijsku kulturu, udruge civilnog društva koja je posvećena neformalnom medijskom obrazovanju djece, roditelja, nastavnika i stručnih suradnika. Sedam je godina bila zaposlena na Edward Bernays Visokoj školi za komunikacijski menadžment na kojoj je obnašala dužnost prodekanice za znanost i upravljanje kvalitetom. Dvije je godine obnašala dužnost predsjednice Matičnog povjerenstva za društvene znanosti Vijeća veleučilišta ili visokih škola Republike Hrvatske. Kao članica Povjerenstva sudjelovala je u postupku inicijalne akreditacije i reakreditacije nekoliko domaćih i stranih visokih učilišta. Članica suradnica je Znanstvenog vijeća za odgoj i obrazovanje Hrvatske akademije znanosti i umjetnosti. Urednica je nekoliko knjiga i zbornika radova, a pet je godina bila i glavna urednica znanstvenog časopisa Communication Management Review te predsjednica Organizacijskog i supredsjednica Programskog odbora znanstvene konferencije Communication Management Forum. U svom se istraživačkom i znanstvenom radu osobito bavi odnosom medija i djece te medijskom pismenošću
en: Asst. Ph.D. Lana Ciboci Perša is employed in Croatia Catholic University. She teaches as an external associate and at Faculty of Croatian Studies and the Faculty of Teacher Education University of Zagreb. She is the vice president of the Society for communication and media culture, civil society associations that are dedicated to informal media education of children, parents, teachers and professional associates. For seven years she was employed at Edward Bernays College of Communication Management where held the position of vice dean for science and management quality. For two years, she held the position of president of Maticno commissions for social sciences of the Council of polytechnics or colleges school of the Republic of Croatia. She participated as a member of the Commission in the process of initial accreditation and reaccreditation of several domestic and foreign universities. She is an associate member Scientific Council for Education of the Croatian Academy science and art. She is the editor of several books and anthologies papers, and for five years she was the editor-in-chief of the scientific journal of Communication Management Review magazine and president Organizational and co-president of the Scientific Program Committee of the Communication Management Forum conference. In his own his research and scientific work is particularly concerned with media relations and children and media literacy

Martin Žagar, EMBA je znanstveni savjetnik u području računarske znanosti, čija su područja istraživanja povezana su s multimedijskim tehnologijama, visokoperformansnim i distribuiranim računarstvom, sažimanjem podataka, računalnim arhitekturama i telemedicinom. Martin je član Akademije tehničkih znanosti Hrvatske te je autor više od 100 znanstvenih radova. Kao član observatorija za digitalne platforme EU sudjeluje u nadzoru algoritama za obradu podataka na digitalnim platformama, a kao istraživač za vođenje i istraživanje na brojnim istraživačkim i industrijskim projektima. Ph.D. Martin Žagar, EMBA is a scientific advisor at in the field of computer science, whose areas of research are are connected with multimedia technologies, high-performance and distributed computing, data compression, computer architectures and telemedicine. Martin is a member of the Technical Academy of Science in Croatia and is the author of more than 100 scientific papers. As a member of the observatory for digital platforms of the EU participates in the supervision algorithms for data processing on digital platforms, and as researcher for conducting and conducting research on numerous research and industrial projects. At an American college, he teaches subjects with study Web and Mobile Computing BS, and Information Technology and Analytics MS.

hr: Dr.sc. Ana Havelka Meštrović je znanstveni suradnik iz interdisciplinarnih područja znanosti, kognitivne znanosti, psihologije i medicine. Uz višegodišnje iskustvo u nastavnom radu, završila je i međunarodnu edukaciju iz integrativne psihoterapije te je licencirani psihoterapeut od strane European Association of Integrative Psychotherapy (EAIP). Kao Fullbrightov stipendist i gostujući znanstvenik provela je šest mjeseci na prestižnom sveučilištu Stanford radeći na istraživanjima iz područja stresa i tjeskobe. Suvlasnica je privatne psihološke/psihijatrijske ordinacije MensSana d.o.o. gdje se specijalizirala za programe upravljanja stresom kod djelatnika velikih korporacija sa primjenama metoda iz područja biofeedbacka i neurofeedbacka. Prisustvuje mnogobrojnim konferencijama i autorica i/ili koautorica je mnogobrojnih znanstvenih publikacija. Na američkom koledžu RIT Croatia predaje predmete iz područja psihologije.
en: Ph.D. Ana Havelka Meštrović is a research associate from interdisciplinary fields of science, cognitive science, psychology and medicine. With years of experience in teaching, she also completed international education in integrative psychotherapy and is a licensed psychotherapist by the European Association of Integrative Psychotherapy (EAIP). As a Fulbright scholar and she spent six months as a visiting scientist at the prestigious Stanford University working on research in the field of stress and anxiety. She is the co-owner of a private psychological/psychiatric practice offices of MensSana d.o.o. where she specialized in programs stress management in employees of large corporations with applying methods from the field of biofeedback and neurofeedback. She attends numerous conferences and is the author and/or she is the co-author of numerous scientific publications. In American teaches subjects in the field of psychology at the RIT Croatia college.

He acquired the technological aspect through his work at the AI startup Mindsmiths working on AI projects in industries such as healthcare, telecommunications, banking and e-commerce. Your understanding human emotions and the specificity of human relationships with brands he acquired outside the world of technology, and we can trace his roots find in the media industry, where he started his career as a TV producer. He was the brain behind some of the most popular Croatian TV shows that regularly kept millions of viewers glued to small screens. Experiences from the world of media gave him a unique a perspective that he successfully integrated into the world of art intelligence.

Master's degree in nutrition with extensive experience in marketing and management, Ivana founded Nutrilife in 2016 Center – the first nutritional and diagnostic center in Croatia. In one place, the center provides all the necessary services in order to clients set off on a new and healthier life journey. Ivana is also ambassador of WelleCo products and representative for the Adria region of these premium nutritional supplements backed by a business woman and inimitable model Elle Macpherson. The "most famous" nutritionist in Croatia is Ivana supporter of a healthy lifestyle. Her availability, dedication and discretion are qualities that set her apart from others, and because whose clients include numerous famous people.

en: Dubravka Srkulj is an extremely experienced expert in the field digital marketing. Despite his profession as a psychologist already more since the age of 12, he has been devoting his career to improving himself in the world digital marketing. Her interest in behavior analysis consumer on the Internet quickly transformed her into an expert on Google and Facebook advertising. Dubravka's professional path in particular is oriented towards the concept of growth hacking, which led her to outstanding results in campaigns for large companies like A1 Croatia, Bruketa&Žinić&Grey, Agrokor, Studio Moderna and many others others. She extends her extraordinary experience to A1 Croatia, where she worked as an expert in digital advertising. She was also a part of agile team to implement SalesForce tools in the area digital promotion channels and the use of DMP segments for advertising in telecommunications. He is currently developing his career in the position of marketing and PR manager in LAQO insurance where successfully implements and transfers the knowledge that ultimately results excellent projects such as the introduction of GPT technology to the user experience, creating the first insurance museum in the metaverse and creation of campaigns at the national level for all communications channels.

Provela je 2 godine u Nestlé HQ-u u Švicarskoj kao članica Nestlé Global Digital Acceleration Team (DAT), leadership programa za Nestlé talente diljem svijeta, gdje je blisko surađivala na različitim projektima s globalnim timovima iz Googlea, Mete, Pinteresta i drugih partnera. Tijekom boravka u Švicarskoj, stekla je dodatno iskustvo radeći u Global Dairy Strategic Business Unit. Po povratku u Hrvatsku, vodila je digitalnu transformaciju Nestlé Adriatic regije te je ujedno započela s postavljanjem eCommerce-a na tržište i njegovom daljnjom akceleracijom. Godine 2022. prešla je iz odjela za komunikacije u FOOD kategoriju, gdje sada vodi eBusiness agendu u 9 zemalja i paralelno ima nekoliko Zone Europe pilot projekata. Osim toga, odgovorna je za usavršavanje digitalnih sposobnosti FOOD marketing i trade marketing timova. Strast prema inovacijama, izazovima i novim iskustvima, tjera je na stalno učenje i primjenu u svemu što radi. To ju je dovelo do potpuno novog područja na temu održivog razvoja, gdje je upravo dobila dodatnu ulogu za FOOD kategoriju u regiji. U slobodno vrijeme je FIBA licencirani košarkaški pomoćni sudac.
en: Valentina Golub started her career at Nestlé before the age of 16 years, where she held various roles and categories at Nestlé portfolio in marketing, digital sector, data and analytics, consumer engagement services, e-business and e-commerce. Spent spent 2 years at Nestlé HQ in Switzerland as a member of Nestlé Global Digital Acceleration Team (DAT), a leading talent program around the world, working closely on different projects with global teams from Google, Meta, Pinterest and other partners. During her stay in Switzerland, she gained additional experience working in Global Dairy Strategic Business Unit. Upon returning to Croatia, led the digital transformation of the Adriatic region and at the same time started with placing eCommerce on the market and its further development acceleration. In 2022, she moved from the communications department to FOOD category, where he now leads the e-business and e-commerce agenda in 9 countries and in parallel there are several pilot projects of Zone Europe. In addition, responsible for building the digital capabilities of the teams for FOOD marketing and trade marketing. Passionate about innovation, challenges and new experiences, forces her to constantly learn and apply in everything he does. This led her to a whole new area expertise and the theme of sustainability, where she just got an additional leading role for the governance and country category in SEM. At leisure time FIBA licensed basketball table official (referee).

hr: Monika je psihologinja koja radi kao stručnjakinja za brendiranje poslodavaca u AI startupu Mindsmiths. Odgovorna je za razvoj i provedbu strategija i inicijativa za privlačenje i zadržavanje vrhunskih talenata prikazivanjem vrijednosti, kulture i mogućnosti tvrtke. Ona također gradi i promiče jedinstveni identitet i ugled organizacije kao poslodavca. Prije nego što je preuzela svoju sadašnju ulogu, radila je u odjelu za odnose s programerima i marketing.

She is responsible for the development and implementation of attraction and retention strategies and initiatives top talents by showcasing values, culture and opportunities companies. It also builds and promotes a unique identity and reputation organization as an employer. Before she took over hers current role, she worked in the developer relations department and marketing.

Ida je tamo vodila odjel u okviru konzaltinga specijaliziran za Digital i Customer experience rješenja. Trenutno zajedno s NEAR Balkans Hub timom i partnerima globalno radi na ostvarenju misije rasta web3 eko-sustava u više od 7 zemalja kroz edukacije, evente, razvoj web3 proizvoda, partnerstva, davanje grantova.
en: Ida Pandur is the general manager for the region of one of the largest of the world's blockchain ecosystem NEAR. She finished her undergraduate degree marketing studies at the Faculty of Economics in Zagreb. During study, Ida joined the newly established as the second employee social media agency iSTUDIO (Degordian) where she worked as VP and led clients, digital strategies and implementation, built and scaled teams, products. After that, she started her own digital agency Entourage, which, in addition to working with clients such as Microsoft, Philips and Bayer, also developed technological products with partners like Spano and strategies for leading tourism destinations with consulting firms such as Horwath HTL. After 4 Croatia acquired its business setup and team in 2008 a branch of the global big4 consulting firm EY. Currently together with the NEAR Balkans Hub team and partners globally to achieve the growth mission of web3 eco-system in more than 7 countries through education, events, development web3 products, partnerships, grants.

hr: Belma Gutlić je potpredsjednica inženjerstva tvrtke za razvoj web3 infrastrukture ChainSafe. Her story with blockchain development the application starts in 2017 and with the establishment of a startup company NodeFactory with which she made her first exit. The rest of the time invests in building and educating the local crypto community through non-profit and volunteer associations UBIK and Alice in Blockchains.
