Nakon završenog studija prava na Sveučilištu u Zagrebu radila je kao pravnica u javnobilježničkom uredu Addiko banke d.d. te je bio partner u odvjetničkom društvu Bardek, Lisac, Mušec, Skoko, Šarolić d.o.o. Godine 2013. Marijana je osnovala vlastiti odvjetnički ured i od tada pruža podršku startup i tehnološkim tvrtkama u svakodnevnom poslovanju, ulaganju, radnom i regulatornom okviru. Posljednjih 10 godina Marijana je startup mentorica u ZIP-u danas ALGEBRA LAB i aktivno je sudjelovala kao osnivačica CroAI-a (Hrvatske udruge za umjetnu inteligenciju) POČETNA | CroAI te osnivač i potpredsjednik CRO STARTUP CroStartup – Hrvatski startup ekosustav. Marijana je diplomirala na Cotrugli Business School 2014. godine kao članica EMBA X generacije. Od 2017. aktivna je članica hrvatskog i regionalnog Data Science i AI ekosustava držeći predavanja, sudjelujući na panelima i javnim nastupima o regulatornom okviru umjetne inteligencije i pitanjima vezanim uz etiku umjetne inteligencije, a na događaju je održala predavanje o umjetnoj inteligenciji na TEDx Zagreb. Marijana je 2016. godine suosnivala NVO PWMN HRVATSKA /PWN ZAGREB pwn.hr koja promiče rodno uravnoteženo vodstvo u profesionalnom okruženju i od tada je predsjednica organizacije. Osim toga, bila je aktivna članica MBA Croatia i trenutno obnaša svoj drugi mandat kao članica Nadzornog odbora.
en: Born in Split in 1978. After completing law studies at At the University of Zagreb, she worked as a lawyer in the notary's office to the office of Addiko banka d.d. and was a partner in a law firm Bardek, Lisac, Mušec, Skoko, Šarolić d.o.o. In 2013, Marijana founded her own law office and has been providing support ever since startups and technology companies in their daily business, investment, working and regulatory framework. The last 10 years Marijana is a startup mentor in ZIP today ALGEBRA LAB and actively participated as the founder of CroAI (Croatian Association for Artificial intelligence) HOME | CroAI and founder and vice president of CRO STARTUP CroStartup – Croatian startup ecosystem. It's Marijana graduated from Cotrugli Business School in 2014 as a member X generation EMBA. Since 2017, she has been an active member of the Croatian i of the regional Data Science and AI ecosystem by giving lectures, participating in panels and public presentations on the regulatory framework artificial intelligence and issues related to the ethics of artificial intelligence intelligence, and at the event she gave a lecture on artificial intelligence intelligence at TEDx Zagreb. Marijana co-founded in 2016 NGO PWMN CROATIA /PWN ZAGREB pwn.hr which promotes gender balanced leadership in a professional environment and has been ever since president of the organization. In addition, she was an active member of the MBA Croatia is currently serving its second mandate as a member of the Supervisory Board of the board.

hr: Martina Čičko Karapetrić i Morana Tomašević, dizajnerice su poznatog modnog branda Boudoir. Nakon formalnog obrazovanja u Školi primijenjene umjetnosti i dizajna u Zagrebu, smjer tekstila i odjeće, i Tekstilno-tehnološkog fakulteta, smjer modnog dizajna, u rujnu 2001. godine, pokreću modni studio Boudoir, čiji dizajnerski potpis je nevjerojatno prepoznatljiv, pamtljiv i drugačiji, u čijem se središtu nalazi dirljiva čežnja prema iznimno romantičnim, maštovitim i uvijek izuzetno ženstvenim kreacijama. Paralelno s radom u modnoj industriji, od 2009. godine, uspješno se bave grafičkim i 3D dizajnom na platformi Second Life koju koristi više od 20 milijuna ljudi iz cijelog svijeta, gdje dizajniraju odjeću, modne dodatke, strukture i home & decor objekte za avatare. Članicama ULUPUH-a postaju 2011. godine, 2012 postavljaju autorsku izložbu Paralelni modni svjetovi koja se bavi problematikom izrade odjeće, paralelno u stvarnom i virtualnom životu, predstavljajući dvije simultane izložbe u galeriji Ulupuh i na Second Life platformi sa identičnim haljinama u 3D obliku i u stvarnosti. U periodu 2016. – 2019. djeluju kao europski ambasadori strukovnog obrazovanja i cjeloživotnog učenja, zbog svoje strasti prema neformalnom vidu cjeloživotne edukacije kojom su proširile svoje vještine na nova područja dizajna.
en: Martina Čičko Karapetrić and Morana Tomašević are designers of the famous fashion brand Boudoir. After formal education in School of applied art and design in Zagreb, majoring in textiles and clothing, and the Faculty of Textile Technology, majoring in fashion design, in September 2001, they start the fashion studio Boudoir, whose the designer's signature is incredibly recognizable, memorable and different, at the center of which is a touching longing for extremely romantic, imaginative and always extremely feminine creations. In parallel with working in the fashion industry, since 2009. year, they successfully deal with graphic and 3D design on the platform Second Life used by more than 20 million people from all over the world of the world, where they design clothes, fashion accessories, structures and home & decor objects for avatars. They became members of ULUPUH in 2011. in 2012, they set up the author's exhibition Parallel Fashion Worlds which deals with the issue of making clothes, in parallel in the real and virtual life, presenting two simultaneous exhibitions in Ulupuh gallery and on the Second Life platform with identical dresses in 3D form and in reality. In the period 2016-2019, they act as European ambassadors of vocational education and lifelong learning, because of his passion for the informal form of lifelong education with which they expanded their skills to new areas of design.

hr: Dubravka je pravni partner Crowea, jedne od vodećih konzultantskih tvrtki u Hrvatskoj. Sa svojim dubokim poznavanjem lokalnih zahtjeva i obveza usklađenosti, ona je pouzdani savjetnik za lokalne i međunarodne klijente o pitanjima korporativnog i građanskog prava, posebno o: dubinskim analizama, strukturiranju i pregovorima spajanja i preuzimanja, ugovaranju, radnom pravu i savjetovanju o privatnosti podataka , itd. U svojoj karijeri napravila je mnoga poslovna strukturiranja i savjetovala mnoge startupove kako bi mogli započeti svoj posao na pravoj nozi. Dubravka upravlja mnogim prekograničnim i međunarodnim projektima dok se bavi akvizicijom klijenata, poslovnim razvojem i dodatnim samoobrazovanjem i treninzima. Snažan fokus industrije na IT, nekretnine, turizam, potrošačke proizvode i usluge te transport.
en: Dubravka is a legal partner of Crowe, one of the leading consulting firms companies in Croatia. With his deep knowledge of the local compliance requirements and obligations, she is a trusted advisor for local and international clients on matters of corporate and of civil law, especially about: in-depth analyses, structuring and merger and takeover negotiations, contracting, labor law and consulting on data privacy, etc. In his career she made many business structurings and advised many startups so that they can start their business on the right foot. Dubravka manages many cross-border and international projects while dealing with client acquisition, business development and additional self-education and training. Strong industry focus on IT, real estate, tourism, consumer products and services, and transportation.

hr: Reno je Međunarodni Crowe partner za vezu s dokazanom poviješću rada u industriji profesionalnih usluga. Reno ima preko 20 godina radnog iskustva u području računovodstva, revizije i financijskog savjetovanja. Osnovao je Crowe u Hrvatskoj i odgovoran je za strateški razvoj zagrebačkog ureda. Zbog svog velikog iskustva u M&A i korporativnim financijama - specijaliziran za usluge revizije, financijskog savjetovanja i transakcija, Reno je savjetovao brojne korporativne i privatne klijente o optimizaciji njihove računovodstvene i porezne pozicije.
en: Reno is an International Crowe relationship partner with a proven track record work in the professional services industry. Reno is over 20 years old work experience in the field of accounting, auditing and finance consultations. He founded Crowe in Croatia and is responsible for strategic development of the Zagreb office. Due to his extensive experience in M&A and corporate finance - specialized services auditing, financial consulting and transactions, Reno is advised numerous corporate and private clients on optimization their accounting and tax positions.

hr: Roko Marović je rođen u Splitu, gdje završava IV. gimnaziju “Marko Marulić”, potom migrira u Zagreb te zbog iznimne strasti upisuje nutricionizam na PBF-u. Tijekom studija se uz kolegu Talana ističe kao najbolji student, stoga posljedično 2016. godine dobiva i dekanovu nagradu za izvrsnost, a potom završava i prediplomski studij nutricionizam. Krajem iste godine upisuje diplomski studij nutricionizam te zajedno s kolegom Talanom pokreće nutricionistički centar “Nutrivision”, koji se već tokom 2017. etablirao kao pouzdan i kvalitetan izvor najvažnijih saznanja iz područja nutricionizma. Vječno željan novih izazova, na početku 2018. godine Roko odlazi na stručnu praksu u Sevillu, u sklopu koje radi u laboratoriju te finalizira eksperimentalni dio svog diplomskog rada. 2019. godine je obranio diplomski rad te stekao zvanje magistra nutricionizma. Paralelno Nutrivision doživljava intezivan rast, stoga je Roko danas osobni nutricionist brojnim ljudima, prvenstveno rekreativnim i profesionalnim sportašima, ali i predavač na brojnim seminarima, predavanjima, radionicama, itd. No njegova ambicioznost ne poznaje granica pa je odlučivši se okušati u znanstvenim vodama nedavno postao i asistent te upisao doktorat na matičnom fakultetu. Uza sve to, Roko je sve ove godine iznimno aktivan sportaš, igra futsal, rekreativno trči te se bavi vježbama snage s vlastitom tjelesnom masom.
en: Roko Marović was born in Split, where he finished IV. high school "Marko Marulić", then migrates to Zagreb and enrolls due to exceptional passion nutrition at PBF. During his studies, he stands out with his colleague Talana as the best student, so consequently in 2016 he gets i dean's award for excellence, and then completes the undergraduate degree study nutrition. At the end of the same year, he enrolled in graduate studies nutritionism, together with his colleague Talana, drives you nutritional center "Nutrivision", which already in 2017 established as a reliable and high-quality source of the most important knowledge from areas of nutrition. Eternally eager for new challenges, at the beginning In 2018, Roko will go on an internship in Seville, as part of who works in the laboratory and finalizes the experimental part of his graduation thesis. In 2019, he defended his graduation thesis and obtained master's degree in nutrition. In parallel, Nutrivision is experiencing intensive growth, therefore Roko is today a personal nutritionist for many people, primarily recreational and professional athletes, but and lecturer at numerous seminars, lectures, workshops, etc. But his ambition knows no bounds, so he made up his mind try the scientific waters, recently became an assistant and enrolled doctorate at the home faculty. In addition to all that, Roko is all this year an extremely active athlete, he plays futsal, runs recreationally and works out strength exercises with your own body weight.

hr: Timothei Jukić je dinamičan i napredan stručnjak koji radi kao regionalni direktor Native Teams, kompanije koja je predvodnik revolucije rada na daljinu i plaćanja u Hrvatskoj i u više od 50+ zemalja diljem svijeta. S oštrim okom za tehnološka rješenja, Timothei je posvećen osnaživanju pojedinaca i tvrtki da iskoriste prednosti rada na daljinu u digitalnom dobu.

role.hr: Head of Unit Cybersecurity Policy Implementation
role.en: Head of Unit Cybersecurity Policy Implementation

hr: Roberto Barcellan rođen je u Padovi (Italija). Studirao je statistiku na Sveučilištu u Padovi i stekao doktorat iz statistike primijenjen na ekonomiji na istom sveučilištu. Godine 1999. pridružio se Europskoj komisiji. Trenutačno vodi Jedinicu zaduženu za implementaciju politike kibernetičke sigurnosti u IT odjelu Europske komisije, subjektu zaduženom za interne politike kibernetičke sigurnosti, upravljanje rizicima i praćenje usklađenosti te cyber-svijest. U svojoj karijeri pokrivao je nekoliko rukovodećih pozicija u Eurostatu, Statističkom uredu Europske komisije (nacionalni računi – proizvodnja; cijene – pariteti kupovne moći – stambena statistika; metodologija i korporativna arhitektura; program implementacije vizije europskog statističkog sustava) te u DIGIT-u, IT odjel Europske komisije (Inovacije, web rješenja i alati; Corporate Knowledge and Decision Making Solutions; Data Services – podaci, rješenja za suradnju i web prisutnost).
en: Roberto Barcellan was born in Padua (Italy). He studied statistics at the University of Padova and earned a doctorate in statistics applied in economics at the same university. In 1999 joined the European Commission. He currently leads the Unit in charge to implement the cyber security policy in the IT department of the European Commission, the entity in charge of internal policies cyber security, risk management and monitoring compliance and cyber-awareness. In his career he covered several management positions in Eurostat, the Statistical Office European Commission (national accounts - production; prices - purchasing power parities – housing statistics; methodology and corporate architecture; implementation program of the European vision statistical system) and in DIGIT, the IT department of the European Commission (Innovations, web solutions and tools; Corporate Knowledge and Decision Making Solutions; Data Services - data, collaboration solutions and web presence).

hr: Sandro Mur je uspješni vizionar i glavni izvršni direktor Bellabeata, hrvatske inovativne tvrtke u sektoru zdravstvenih i wellness tehnologija. Bellabeat je razvio niz revolucionarnih proizvoda, od pametnih nosivih uređaja koji prate vitalne zdravstvene metrike do inovativnih mobilnih aplikacija koje pružaju personalizirane uvide i smjernice. Sandrova karijera obilježena je dubokom predanošću poboljšanju života ljudi kroz vrhunsku tehnologiju. Posjeduje jedinstvenu mješavinu tehničke stručnosti i poslovne oštroumnosti te strastveno želi iskoristiti moć podataka i tehnologije za promicanje zdravijih stilova života i unaprjeđenje područja preventivne zdravstvene zaštite. Njegova strateška vizija, u kombinaciji s predanošću inovacijama usmjerenim na kupca, uzdigla je Bellabeat na čelo digitalne zdravstvene industrije.
en: Sandro Mur is a visionary and the CEO of Bellabeat, an innovative Croatian company in the health and wellness technology sector. Bellabeat has developed a range of groundbreaking products, from smart wearables that track vital health metrics to mobile apps that deliver personalised insights and guidance. Sandro's career is defined by a deep commitment to improving people's lives through cutting-edge technology. He combines technical expertise with business acumen and is passionate about using the power of data and technology to promote healthier lifestyles and advance preventive healthcare. His strategic vision, paired with a dedication to customer-centred innovation, has put Bellabeat at the forefront of the digital health industry.

hr: Vesna Katalinić, dipl.soc.radnica i geštalt psihoterapeutkinja, zaposlena na Hrabrom telefonu od 2007. godine. Tijekom svog radnog vijeka provela je brojne edukacije za roditelje i stručnjake na temu zaštite djece, prevencije nasilja te rada sa zlostavljanom i zanemarenom djecom. Više od 10 godina provodi savjetovanja za djecu i roditelje te Školu za roditelje u okviru savjetovališta Hrabrog telefona „Snaga obitelji“. Trenutno je uključena u provedbu projekta „My follow up“ u kojem radi s djecom žrtvama kaznenih djela i njihovim roditeljima.
en: Vesna Katalinić is a social worker and Gestalt psychotherapist who has worked at Hrabri telefon (the Brave Phone child helpline) since 2007. Over her career she has run numerous training programmes for parents and professionals on child protection, violence prevention and working with abused and neglected children. For more than ten years she has provided counselling for children and parents and led the School for Parents within Hrabri telefon's “Snaga obitelji” counselling centre. She is currently involved in the “My follow up” project, working with children who are victims of crime and their parents.

hr: Damir Firšt je suosnivač i CCO u tvrtki Matterless koja ima misiju dokazati svijetu da su digitalne stvari stvarne stvaranjem igračaka i suputnika u zajedničkoj proširenoj stvarnosti (AR). Antropolog/sociolog po obrazovanju i softverski poduzetnik po struci, Damir istražuje kako tehnologija utječe na kulturu i svijest.
